71938.commentary: (ANa) bhogabyasanasaṃvattaniko'ti yathā kākaṇikāmattam'pi hatthe na tiṭṭhati, evaṃ bhogabyasanaṃ saṃvatteti.

71939.meaning1: leading to hatred by one's rivals
71939.commentary: (ANa) sapattaverasaṃvattaniko hotī'ti saha sapattehi veraṃ saṃvatteti. tassa hi sapattā ca bahukā honti. yo ca naṃ passati, tasmiṃ veram'eva uppādeti na nibbāyati. evarūpo hi parassa rakkhitagopitabhaṇḍe aparādhassa nissando.

examples.text: kāmesumicchācāro, bhikkhave, āsevito bhāvito bahulīkato nirayasaṃvattaniko tiracchānayonisaṃvattaniko pettivisayasaṃvattaniko. yo sabbalahuso kāmesumicchācārassa vipāko, manussabhūtassa sapattaverasaṃvattaniko hoti.

71940.meaning1: leading to false accusation; conducive to misrepresentation through lies
71940.commentary: (ANa) abhūt'abbhakkhāna-saṃvattaniko hotī'ti abhūtena abbhakkhānaṃ saṃvatteti, yena kenaci kataṃ tass'eva upari patati.

examples.text: musāvādo, bhikkhave, āsevito bhāvito bahulīkato nirayasaṃvattaniko tiracchānayonisaṃvattaniko pettivisayasaṃvattaniko. yo sabbalahuso musāvādassa vipāko, manussabhūtassa abhūt'abbhakkhāna-saṃvattaniko hoti.

71941.commentary: (ANa) amanāpasaddasaṃvattaniko'ti amanāpasaddaṃ saṃvatteti. yā sā vācā kaṇṭakā kakkasā kaṭukā abhisajjanī mammacchedikā, gatagataṭṭhāne tam'eva suṇāti, manāpasaddasavanaṃ nāma na labhati. evarūpo pharusavācāya gatamaggo nāma.

examples.text: pharusā, bhikkhave, vācā āsevitā bhāvitā bahulīkatā nirayasaṃvattanikā tiracchānayonisaṃvattanikā pettivisayasaṃvattanikā. yo sabbalahuso pharusāya vācāya vipāko, manussabhūtassa amanāpasaddasaṃvattaniko hoti.

71942.commentary: (ANa) amanāpasaddasaṃvattaniko'ti amanāpasaddaṃ saṃvatteti. yā sā vācā kaṇṭakā kakkasā kaṭukā abhisajjanī mammacchedikā, gatagataṭṭhāne tam'eva suṇāti, manāpasaddasavanaṃ nāma na labhati. evarūpo pharusavācāya gatamaggo nāma.

examples.text: samphappalāpo, bhikkhave, āsevito bhāvito bahulīkato nirayasaṃvattaniko tiracchānayonisaṃvattaniko pettivisayasaṃvattaniko. yo sabbalahuso samphappalāpassa vipāko, manussabhūtassa anādeyyavācāsaṃvattaniko hoti.

71945.meaning1: fortunate human state; prosperous human condition

examples.text: idha pana, bhikkhave, ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu mattaso kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu mattaso kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ n'ābhisambhoti. so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā manussasobhagyaṃ upapajjati.

71946.meaning1: good luck; good fortune; prosperity; success

examples.text: idha pana, bhikkhave, ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu mattaso kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu mattaso kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ n'ābhisambhoti. so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā manussasobhagyaṃ upapajjati.

71947.meaning1: leading to madness; conducive to insanity
71947.commentary: (ANa) ummattakasaṃvattaniko hotī'ti ummattakabhāvaṃ saṃvatteti. tena hi manusso ummatto vā khittacitto vā eḷamūgo vā hoti. ayaṃ surāpānassa nissando.

examples.text: surāmerayapānaṃ, bhikkhave, āsevitaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ nirayasaṃvattanikaṃ tiracchānayonisaṃvattanikaṃ pettivisayasaṃvattanikaṃ. yo sabbalahuso surāmerayapānassa vipāko, manussabhūtassa ummattakasaṃvattaniko hotī'ti.

71948.commentary: (ANa) siṅgīsuvaṇṇan'ti gosiṅgasadisaṃ hutvā uppannattā evaṃ nāmakaṃ suvaṇṇaṃ.

examples.text: etasmiṃ yaṃ vijjati antare dhanaṃ, muttā maṇi veḷuriyañ'ca bhaddakaṃ, siṅgīsuvaṇṇaṃ atha vā'pi kañcanaṃ yaṃ jātarūpaṃ haṭakan'ti vuccati.

71951.commentary: (ANa) kusalehi susamannāhatassā'ti ye vādetuṃ kusalā chekā, tehi vāditassa.

71952.meaning1: section in Saddanīti grammar on roots

examples.text: cāgavatī kho pana hoti vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgī payatapāṇinī vossaggaratā yācayogā dānasaṃvibhāgaratā.

71955.meaning1: giving all the objects of sense desire; providing all the sense pleasures
71955.commentary: (PVa) sabbakāmadan'ti mayhaṃ sabbassa icchit'icchitassa dātāraṃ, sabbesaṃ vā sattānaṃ icchitadāyakaṃ.

examples.text: yo naṃ bharati sabbadā, niccaṃ ātāpi ussuko, taṃ sabbakāmadaṃ posaṃ, bhattāraṃ n'ātimaññati.

71956.meaning1: following (another's) desire; obedient to the will (of)
71956.commentary: (JAa) tava chandavasānugā'ti kacci tava ajjhāsayaṃ tava vasaṃ anuvattati, na attano cittavasena vattatī'ti pucchati.

examples.text: yā evaṃ vattati nārī, bhattu chandavas'ānugā, manāpā nāma te devā, yattha sā upapajjatī'ti.
kacci te sādisī bhariyā, assavā piyabhāṇinī, puttarūpayasūpetā, tava chandavas'ānugā.

71957.meaning1: success in this world; victory here in this life
71957.commentary: (ANt) idhalokavijayāyā'ti idhalokavijinan'atthāya abhibhav'atthāya. yo hi diṭṭhadhammikaṃ anatthaṃ parivajjanavasena abhibhavati, tato eva tadatthaṃ sampādeti, so idhalokavijayāya paṭipanno nāma hoti paccatthikaniggaṇhanato sadatthasampādanato ca.

examples.text: catūhi kho, visākhe, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo idhalokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, ayaṃsa loko āraddho hoti. katamehi catūhi?
kathañ'ca, visākhe, mātugāmo bhattu manāpaṃ carati? idha, visākhe, mātugāmo yaṃ bhattu amanāpasaṅkhātaṃ taṃ jīvitahetu'pi na ajjhācarati. evaṃ kho, visākhe, mātugāmo bhattu manāpaṃ carati.

71959.meaning1: victory in the next world; success in the subsequent life
71959.commentary: (ANt) paralokavijayāyā'ti paralokassa vijinan'atthāya abhibhav'atthāya. yo hi samparāyikaṃ anatthaṃ parivajjanavasena abhibhavati, tato eva tadatthaṃ sampādeti, so paralokavijayāya paṭipanno nāma hoti.

examples.text: catūhi kho, visākhe, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo paralokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, paraloko āraddho hoti. katamehi catūhi?
